title: Chapter 1477
text:
The Star Alliance also had individual strength, but compared to the three Universal Civilizations, their top combatants were too few and too weak. With Han Xiao's abilities, he could do whatever he wanted here.

In addition, the virtual network of the entire Star Alliance area was under the surveillance of Han Xiao, a Transcendent Grade Mechanic. The whereabouts of the upper echelons of the various Star Alliance members could not be hidden at all. Han Xiao was like an eagle pouncing on chicks, constantly teleporting and flashing, accurately intercepting the evacuation fleets of the upper echelons of the Star Alliance members one after another. He did not miss a single time, and even the leader of the Star Alliance did not manage to escape. He was also captured by him.

In just a few days, the leaders and upper echelons of the forty-six civilizations in the Star Alliance became Han Xiao's prisoners.

One civilization after another lost the command from the upper echelons. Some civilizations had a good system and continued to carry out the migration plan through the command chain at the bottom. Some civilizations were rather decisive, and some took up the position of the upper echelons. However, most of them fell into different degrees of chaos.

The intelligence of the World Tree and the three Universal Civilizations was a secret of the upper echelons of the Star Alliance. The people and the officers knew nothing about it. They did not know what the World Tree fleet represented, nor did they have the strong fear of the World Tree Civilization that the upper echelons of the Star Alliance had nurtured for many years. Therefore, after the upper echelons of the various civilizations disappeared, many civilizations launched an intense counterattack, as if they were newborn calves who were not afraid of tigers.

However, due to the collective absence of the upper echelons, the internal secrets were leaked under the influence of a certain force, and it quickly spread among the Star Alliance's grassroots. Most people understood the source of the disaster and learned how terrifying the World Tree Civilization was, as well as the current situation where the World Tree Civilization was at war with the three Universal Civilizations.

As for the operation of the upper echelons of the Star Alliance taking advantage of the situation, under Han Xiao's control, it was not announced. It was still a secret.

Because the World Tree's mechanism was too terrifying, the morale of many civilizations was reduced by more than half.

What completely destroyed the will of the various civilizations in the Star Alliance was the invasion of another armed force. This time, the army that landed in the Star Alliance was the army of the three Universal Civilizations that was supposed to be fighting the World Tree! They had also become attackers!

The morale of the Star Alliance completely collapsed. Faced with the pincer attack of two Universal Civilizations, they no longer had the courage to resist and could only flee in panic.

The entire Star Alliance's battle situation slid into the abyss at lightning speed. All the resistance forces were paralyzed and destroyed by the three Universal Civilizations and the World Tree. Countless spaceships fled the Star Alliance's territory in a hurry, and it was already a mess. Only a month had passed since the World Tree Civilization and the three Universal Civilizations invaded the Star Alliance.

In reality, if the Star Alliance could unify all of its powers, they would at least have a universe-level standard. They wouldn't be so useless, and they would still be able to resist for a period of time if they worked together. However, it happened too suddenly, and there were too many internal differences, making it impossible for them to form an effective counterattack. The current situation of the Star Alliance was like the three Universal Civilizations that had been ambushed by the World Tree in his previous life. Furthermore, the situation was even worse, and they were caught off guard.

If the Star Alliance was given some time, they might be able to recover from the chaos after suffering heavy losses and form various scattered civilian resistance forces. However, there was no chance now.

…

All the upper echelons of the Star Alliance civilizations that were captured by Han Xiao were not executed, nor were they immediately devoured and transformed by the World Tree. Instead, they were all locked in the same cage and were not tortured physically.

However, there were virtual screens floating in the cage, broadcasting the tragic situation of their various civilizations under the attack of the World Tree all day long, making it impossible for all the upper echelons of the Star Alliance to rest peacefully. They endured the psychological torture, and everyone was extremely haggard.

Every day, as they watched the World Tree fleet destroy the Star Alliance, everyone was shocked, angry, and filled with fear and despair. They were in a state of panic.

After the three Universal Civilizations attacked the Star Alliance on the screen, all the imprisoned upper echelons of the Star Alliance were stunned, and their minds went blank.

They had thought that the World Tree was fighting on two fronts, but they did not expect the three Universal Civilizations to attack them as well. In an instant, their previous guesses were overturned, and everyone was shocked.

"Why would the three Universal Civilizations invade our territory with the World Tree Civilization? Aren't they still fighting?"

The haggard Star Alliance Leader's voice was hoarse with unconcealable shock and confusion.

"Did they give up and make peace? No, how is that possible! They shouldn't have given up until they die. Isn't the World Tree unable to coexist with any civilization? "someone muttered in disbelief.

Savignes opened his bloodshot blue eyes and hissed, "There's only one possibility, and that is that the three Universal Civilizations have already been devoured and transformed by the World Tree, becoming its slaves and losing their freedom … In other words, their civilization has already been destroyed! Ahahaha … Wuwuwu … "

As he spoke, Savignes revealed an ugly expression. It was as if he was crying and laughing at the same time, with an inexplicable ruthlessness and joy.

Among all the Star Alliance civilizations that were attacked, the Lore Civilization was the most miserable. They were targeted by the World Tree and the three Universal Civilizations. Savignes watched the tragic scenes his race experienced every day, and his mental state was on the verge of collapse. In his eyes … although he was about to face destruction, at least the three Universal Civilizations were gone. His revenge had succeeded, and he had already dragged his enemies down with him, destroying the prosperous world of the three Universal Civilizations.

Hearing this, everyone nodded silently. They all agreed that the three Universal Civilizations had become the vassals of the World Tree Civilization.

However, unlike Savignes, the other upper echelons of the Star Alliance did not feel any joy, only fear.

Originally, a single World Tree Civilization was enough to destroy the Star Alliance. Now, the other party had even 'absorbed' the forces of the three Universal Civilizations, completing the reinforcement. It was equivalent to two Universal Civilizations attacking from both sides.

No matter how they thought about it, they felt that the Star Alliance had no chance of surviving. Their hearts were filled with despair, and their expressions were numb.

Swoosh!

At this moment, the door of the cage opened, and everyone turned around. A figure walked in against the light of the corridor outside, revealing an expressionless face. It was Han Xiao.

"Everyone, have you been living comfortably?"

Han Xiao spoke with an emotionless tone.

"Black Star!"

Everyone subconsciously shrank back as fear appeared on their faces.

Only Savignes did not retreat. Instead, he took a few steps forward nervously with a ferocious smile on his face. He stretched out his hands as if he wanted to grab Han Xiao's shoulders.

Pa!

Before he could take a few steps, an invisible force swept out and sent Savignes flying. His body was stuck to the wall of the prison with a bang.

However, Savignes did not seem to feel any pain at all. Instead, he laughed crazily as if he was about to stop breathing.

"Hahaha — Black Star! Your three Universal Civilizations have also suffered a crushing defeat and become slaves of the World Tree. We will also become members of the World Tree. We are just equal existences to you. We will all end up the same. Don't think that anyone has won! Haha … cough … haha … "

The upper echelons of the Star Alliance looked at the crazed Savignes and remained silent. There was only dejection on their faces, and there was even pity in their eyes when they looked at Han Xiao.

Although they were destined to become members of the World Tree and did not seem to be dead, losing themselves was no different from death in their eyes.

Seeing this, Han Xiao knew what they were thinking. He did not mind and shook his head.

"Do you think the three Universal Civilizations have become slaves of the World Tree? A reasonable deduction, an interesting guess … Unfortunately, it's a completely wrong conclusion. "

Without waiting for anyone to react, he raised his palm, and a pocket-sized shadow of the Tree of World immediately appeared in his palm. It spun and emitted an astonishingly high-level pressure, so intimidating that everyone present felt weak all over and couldn't stand. One by one, they collapsed to the ground.

"Our war has already ended, but you guessed wrong. The World Tree has been captured by me and has now become my Universal Treasure. In other words … I am the master of the World Tree Civilization."

As soon as he finished speaking, Savignes' crazy and hoarse laughter stopped abruptly, like a screaming chicken that had its throat pinched.

He widened his eyes and stared at Han Xiao.

"Impossible! I don't believe it! The intelligence clearly said that the World Tree Civilization had the upper hand and almost destroyed … "

"Oh? You're talking about the intelligence sent back by the group of monitors you left in the desolate universe belt? "

Without waiting for Savignes to finish, Han Xiao interrupted him and smiled playfully.

"I got someone to make up those battle reports. Are you happy enough?"

As soon as he said that, it was as if he had pressed the mute button. Savignes' anger froze on his face, and the others widened their eyes.

The room suddenly fell silent.

Han Xiao blinked and slowly said, "Your spies have long been discovered by us and transformed into servants of the World Tree. They have been sending you fake information, making you think that we are still in the middle of a war. In fact, we have already taken care of the World Tree more than a year ago. What you see is an illusion that we deliberately made up."

At this moment, everyone's expressions were extremely interesting.

Thinking of the pleasant surprise they had received every time they saw the 'battle report' over the past year, everyone felt as uncomfortable as if they had eaten something delicious.

It turned out that they had been foolishly laughing at the fake information that others had made up. They had been complacent and smug about it, and they had been toyed with by others!

At this moment, everyone wished they could tear off their faces and throw them somewhere they could no longer see.

At the same time, an even deeper sense of despair rose in everyone's hearts. After knowing that this was a mixed double battle, everyone completely lost all hope. Their faces were extremely gloomy, and they knew that the Star Alliance was finished.

Seeing this, Han Xiao shook his head.

Actually, he felt that the Star Alliance was quite unlucky. Even if these people did not take advantage of the situation to stab the three Universal Civilizations in the back, when he defeated the World Tree, he would still use the Information Form warning network to cover all the Star Fields in his territory. This way, the Star Alliance would still have nowhere to hide and would still be exposed.

At that time, the Star Alliance would still be watched and vigilant by the three Universal Civilizations, and their outcome would not be any better … Therefore, the moment the Star Alliance sent spies to investigate the galactic society, their outcome was almost destined.

The leader of the Star Alliance clenched his fists and gritted his teeth. "What do you want to do to us if you don't devour us?"

Han Xiao glanced at them and said, "I need everyone's cooperation. As you can see, we have the ability to destroy all the civilizations in the Star Alliance, but I will give your race a chance. Stop resisting, choose to submit, and become our subsidiary … Only then will we give you the right to continue."

"You can completely devour us. Why are you doing this?" The leader of the Star Alliance was furious.

"I like it." Han Xiao raised his brows. He paused for a moment, glanced at everyone, and continued, "Think about it. You only have one chance …"

At this moment, Savignes suddenly roared and interrupted him.

"We will never give up our freedom and become the World Tree's vassals! Don't even think about enslaving us … "

However, before he could finish, Han Xiao flicked his finger, and mechanical particles flew out, forming a mechanical closure device that covered the lower half of Savignes' face, blocking his roar back into his chest.

Han Xiao retracted his gaze and said with a calm expression, "It seems like he has already made his choice. Before the Lore Civilization is destroyed, he will not be executed. He will be here to see the results of his choice … Everyone, it's your turn. Because I was interrupted just now, I'll repeat myself. The three Universal Civilizations can destroy you effortlessly. If you refuse me, you won't even have the chance to reproduce under the World Tree's jurisdiction. Destroy or continue, think carefully."

Everyone's expressions were uncertain as they fell into an endless dilemma.

They knew that this was an example to others, but this move was still very effective. They wanted to say that they would never become slaves, but looking at the miserable state of their race on the virtual screen, they felt the burden on their shoulders become heavier and heavier, making them unable to open their mouths.

At this moment, mechanical particles flowed out from under Han Xiao's robe and turned into a fixed cabin, locking Savignes up and making him unable to move. This attracted everyone's sympathetic gazes.

"Don't worry, you have plenty of time. Before our fleet destroys your civilization, you can hesitate as much as you want. After all, the ones dying in battle are not you."

Han Xiao said this and left under everyone's terrified and unwilling gazes.

The cell door closed behind him, cutting off Savignes' struggling groans.

Han Xiao did not stop walking, and the officers of the three Universal Civilizations were already waiting at the door. Seeing this, they quickly followed.

"Your Excellency Black Star, thank you for your hard work," Teny said.

"It's nothing. I'll leave the rest to you guys."

Han Xiao waved his hands.

He had already helped to this extent, and the Star Alliance had already lost the ability to resist. The rest of the work was enough to leave to the three Universal Civilizations. With the World Tree Civilization working together, he did not need to do anything else.

The three Universal Civilizations were still capable of completing such a simple task.

"I didn't expect it to be resolved so smoothly … A civilization that has stepped into the threshold of the Universe level was easily disintegrated in such a short time. My organization has actually expanded to this level."

Han Xiaoxin sighed inwardly before striding away.
